commit.message:
Fixes #34440: split multi-column partition keys and dedupe CockroachDB partition columns (#34499)

* fix(ingestion): split multi-column partition keys and dedupe CockroachDB partition columns

* fix(ingestion): split CockroachDB partition keys on the ", " separator

CockroachDB joins partition key columns into crdb_internal.partitions.column_names
with ", " and emits identifiers unquoted, so a bare "," split tore a column
named `a,b` apart and the real-column check then dropped it silently. Split on
", ", log any dropped tokens, and cover sub-partitioned tables and identifiers
containing a comma or a space end to end.

---------
